text:
I found why tm is not fully discovered, Your tutorial is correct ... with another uart tm appears.

It is necessary to configure IBUS telemetry in the inav (I use inav) ports tab on another (a second) uart.
The new uart tx (fc side) pin must be connected to sensor ibus signal pin on the receiver (I use ia6b receiver) as You describe in this video. 
Since on the fc electric ground is common, I just added one connection pin2pin to the overall setup.
Quite easy ...

Flysky documentation is not clear about this, and many infos on internet seem to refer different obsolete hw ia6b receiver models, declaring that telemetry is not available, or that Ibus is half-duplex.
A big mess ...

Hope this post/comment can be helpful to other guys !!! ...

Alfredo
